title: Add --max-iterations flag to rocket loop
description: Add an optional --max-iterations <n> flag to the loop command. The flag accepts a positive integer with a default of 10. Invalid values should show a user-friendly error.
acceptanceCriteria: --max-iterations flag is registered on the loop command
Default value is 10 when not specified
rocket loop --max-iterations 5 passes the value to the loop runner
Non-integer values show an error and exit non-zero
Negative values show an error and exit non-zero

steps.description: Add --max-iterations option to loop command in src/cli.ts
steps.details: Update the loop command registration to include: `.option('--max-iterations <n>', 'Maximum number of loop iterations', '10')`

steps.description: Parse and validate --max-iterations in loop command handler
steps.details: In src/commands/loop.ts, parse the option: `const maxIterations = parseInt(options.maxIterations, 10)`. Validate: `if (isNaN(maxIterations) || maxIterations < 1) { console.error('--max-iterations must be a positive integer'); process.exit(1) }`

steps.description: Update loop command handler type signature
steps.details: Update the options type in loopCommand: `options: { claude?: boolean; docker?: boolean; maxIterations: string }`. Commander parses options as strings, so parseInt is needed.

Run `npm run dev -- loop --max-iterations 5` and verify value is parsed. Run `npm run dev -- loop --max-iterations abc` and verify error message appears. Run `npm run dev -- loop --max-iterations -1` and verify error.

technicalNotes: Commander stores option values as strings by default — always parseInt/parseFloat when expecting numbers
The default value '10' in option() is stored as a string, consistent with other option values
